evidence_class_definitions.H: conjectured relationship or formal model; empirical testing may still require operational definitions

claims.statement: The inspected source closure supports static reconstruction, not a new product execution.
limitations: No product import, test, CI, provider call or installed qualification was performed.

claims.statement: 163 reading copies include 157 exact copies and six separate full-blob-matched reconstructions after removal of one extra final LF.
limitations: Not a complete fresh repository audit; reading-copy identities remain distinct.

claims.statement: Historical 46 plus 3 and 59 selected case reports do not establish a fresh current-source pass.
limitations: Underlying archives were not all independently inspected; no live-model or installed three-node qualification follows.

claims.statement: There is no invariant smallest semantic packet across byte, text, token, claim, artifact and event operations.
limitations: Minimality is relative to a specified operation and context.

claims.statement: Byte hashing and canonical-object hashing are different identity domains.
limitations: Canonicalization is not a signature; no JCS conformance asserted.

claims.statement: Intake contextual reuse binds complete selected prior pairs and rejects overflow rather than silently truncating.
limitations: 16 prior messages means at most eight complete pairs; the 16000-byte check applies to canonical effective messages on this path, not universal model limits.

claims.statement: Gateway actor identity derives from authenticated application context, and custody records attempts before admission.
limitations: An actor string or source instruction cannot recreate that authority.

claims.statement: Record idempotency uses actor and key with exact raw-payload semantics.
limitations: Changed bytes conflict; an uncertain outcome still needs reconciliation.

claims.statement: Observation mode retains the compatibility admission plan as definition-only and performs separate advisory business assessment later; legacy non-observation modes execute the admission plan.
limitations: Do not generalize one profile to every mode.
Application privacy checks consent and configured policy identifier; native checks carried Boolean/basis contract, not content classification or universal policy adequacy.

claims.statement: Dispatch binds exact record/version/request and reserves accounting before provider invocation.
limitations: Reservation is not completion or monetary charge.

claims.statement: The synthetic original source has 9 UTF-8 bytes; normalized source 7; excerpt 6 bytes and 5 code points.
limitations: Not admitted or executed; actual request context remains symbolic.

claims.statement: Application normalization is many-to-one and retains original identity separately.
limitations: No general inverse or universal semantic preservation.

claims.statement: The native grounding source on this route is already-normalized seven-byte text, not original nine-byte input.
limitations: Direct lower-level grounding is a distinct route.

claims.statement: Wrapper, canonical message array, native segment, manifest and semantic capture occupy distinct byte domains.
limitations: 161, 200, 243, 525 and 684 bytes are not a live end-to-end resource benchmark.

claims.statement: Provider adapters have protocol-specific bounded nonstreaming text contracts.
limitations: No universal tokenizer/template equivalence; unsupported output is not silently accepted text.

claims.statement: The transport observes application response bodies rather than network frames or actual token boundaries.
limitations: No packet capture or negotiated-session attestation was performed.
TLS does not hide readable source/context values from the authorized compute endpoint or privileged retaining host.

claims.statement: Observed body bytes and retained prefix bytes have separate identities; EOF and cleanup are separate observations.
limitations: Cancellation or lost acknowledgement does not prove remote nonexecution.

claims.statement: Actual tokenizer IDs, hidden tensors, decoding state and energy are outside the inspected trace.
limitations: Transformer equations are conditional background only.

claims.statement: Completion is modeled as separately tracked admission, dispatch, body, normalization, evaluation, posture, review, use, payload and cleanup coordinates.
limitations: Not a newly implemented unified runtime schema.

claims.statement: Semantic bridge claims are paragraph/line spans with first exact-substring support proposals.
limitations: No proposition induction, entailment or exhaustive source selection.

claims.statement: Downstream captured-adapter raw output is derived semantic JSON, not original provider body.
limitations: The facade makes no model call; upstream and derived hashes remain separate.

claims.statement: Claim validation reconstructs identity and coordinates, while lexical coverage is not factual likelihood.
limitations: Citation verification does not establish source truth, adequacy or independence.

claims.statement: Candidate labels use 24-hex digest prefixes over 128 ASCII seed bytes; full artifact hashes remain separate.
limitations: 96-bit labels are not full artifact digests; source labels use 20-hex prefixes.

claims.statement: Default UCM axes are structural proxies (r,1,1,1-u,r).
limitations: Not empirical GUFT or ethical/physical measurements.

claims.statement: UCM computes stable softmax and complete equivalence-group masses; top-k is display only.
limitations: Scores are caller-declared logits, not calibrated log likelihoods.
Population is nonempty, groups partition it, masses are ordered, and second-group mass is zero for a singleton.

claims.statement: A singleton softmax mass of one is normalization, not correctness certainty.
limitations: No empirical calibration follows from the algebra.

claims.statement: Every successful ordinary CAPTURED to JOINED bridge build sets u=1.0 and therefore reaches UCM REFUSE under the unchanged threshold.
claims.scope: Exact inspected ordinary captured-model JOINED route
limitations: Conditional on valid artifacts reaching UCM; not all models/routes; inspectability remains.

claims.statement: CAPTURE_ONLY, non-model events and direct lower-level capture API are separate paths.
limitations: No invented confidence value is authorized by their existence.

claims.statement: The native waveform is a synthetic five-axis codec with no physical-frequency claim.
limitations: No established cross-domain utility or neuroscience measurement.

claims.statement: Before rounding, codec energy is sum(a_k^2)/50 and equals .08 for the witness axes.
claims.scope: Discrete orthogonality for the stated five harmonics and sample counts
limitations: Not an executed waveform result; scalar energy loses axis allocation.

claims.statement: Counterexample search is a bounded unsupported-claim and limitation-token scan.
limitations: Zero matches is not exhaustive falsification.

claims.statement: Aperture hard-gate failure precedes softer holds; ordinary PMR is off while evidence custody persists.
limitations: No PMR write does not mean no files or content storage.
The privacy gate checks a carried Boolean/basis contract; optional PMR consent is distinct from required custody retention.

claims.statement: Sophia recomputes selected derived relationships but does not independently read raw quarantine or rerun UCC policy predicates.
limitations: Parent hashes do not establish independent upstream byte access.

claims.statement: Conditional witness UCM/aperture REFUSE yields correctly recorded Sophia HOLD and Atlas quarantine/do_not_publish.
limitations: Not an observed run; malformed artifacts can instead reject; candidate remains inspectable.

claims.statement: Sealing follows actual audit/orientation/TEL completion and inventories bytes without certifying semantic truth.
limitations: No signature, privileged-host immutability or automatic publication follows.

claims.statement: GUFT quantities require namespace, estimator version, units, producer, consumer and missingness distinctions.
limitations: Not a universal runtime schema already enforced.

claims.statement: ET is bounded for bounded operands, but its bound does not validate the operands as intended constructs.
claims.scope: Local product and retained proof terms
limitations: No fresh Lean compilation or axiom audit.

claims.statement: Exploratory stability Psi is a distinct ratio with unresolved domains and no universal unit interval bound.
limitations: Lock Lambda differs from maximum drift; epsilon does not guarantee positive signed denominator.

claims.statement: The full Formula-of-Record equation was not recovered and is not reconstructed from its name.
limitations: Its absence in this search is not proof no original exists.

claims.statement: Historical benchmark telemetry uses dimensionless numeric transforms and favorable missing-input defaults.
limitations: Mixed units are not normalized physically; empty numbers yield E=1.
Divisor 80 was chosen to keep E high enough for Psi gates, not by semantic calibration.

claims.statement: Historical DeltaS and Lambda summarize rerun vector distances and can be zero for no reruns.
limitations: Repeated workload has no explicit controlled perturbation parameter; zero is not proven robustness.

claims.statement: Inspected text-facing benchmark consumer does not use candidate text to construct its measurement.
limitations: Track association is not candidate-semantic measurement or telemetry-to-river adapter.

claims.statement: Historical potential/integrity/lifecycle heuristics are distinct from probability, truth and durable dependency pruning.
limitations: Integrity is unbounded; favorable denominator does not establish accuracy.

claims.statement: Time-series differences lack elapsed-time division and net flux telescopes to endpoint change.
limitations: Not per-second derivative, Shannon entropy or current native waveform.

claims.statement: Phase-weighted donor diagnostics and the synthetic native waveform belong to distinct quantity families.
limitations: Cross-domain cognitive transfer is separately hypothetical.
C_plus+C_minus=Psi; Q_perp is separate, not a third additive energy share. Units follow selected Psi; physical power needs a signal model and averaging interval.

claims.statement: Full graph-field research laws include terms absent from the actual reduced river/terrace kernels.
limitations: No empirical density-to-knowledge mapping is established.

claims.statement: Actual evolution caller overrides river default h=.05 and terrace default h=.1 with h=1.0.
limitations: Source existence is not execution; actual graph spectrum is unavailable.
The terrace phase consumes the newly updated clipped river field and recomputes g from unchanged Psi.

claims.statement: Unclipped fixed-input river Euler strict decay requires 0<h<2/(D_r*lambda_max+beta).
claims.scope: Finite undirected nonnegative weights, fixed Psi, D_r>=0, beta>0
limitations: Not sufficient for semantic utility, all-input admissibility, or actual production stability.

claims.statement: At h=1 and default coefficients stability requires lambda_max<23.75; positivity suffices when degree<=11.25.
limitations: Strict stability differs from positivity and from upper-range preservation.
Positivity additionally requires nonnegative initial R and alpha*g>=0.

claims.statement: A hypothetical two-node weight-20 fixed-Psi graph yields multiplier -2.3 at h=1 and .835 at h=.05.
limitations: Not a project test or actual deployed graph.

claims.statement: With clipping the same hypothetical example alternates exactly between (1,0) and (0,1).
limitations: Boundedness does not prove convergence or accuracy; not production behavior.

claims.statement: Unclipped symmetric diffusion cancels in total river density, leaving source minus decay.
limitations: River density is generally not conserved; clipping adds projection correction.

claims.statement: Recursive inquiry and complex-state regime formulas remain distinct research models with explicit contraction conditions.
limitations: Bounded forcing does not guarantee convergence; real coordinate need not stay in [0,1].

claims.statement: Existing AHA checks supplied relational mappings and grounded references, not automatic donor discovery or target falsification.
claims.scope: Existing maintained structural case engine and wrapper
limitations: Different declared source-family labels do not prove independence.
Current engine requires exact relation-type/orientation equality; maps associate identifiers and do not execute semantic or unit transforms.

claims.statement: AHA outputs are typed ordinal/structural/qualitative measures and a nonprobabilistic rank, not discovery confidence.
limitations: Semantic non-vacuity assessed and semantic utility demonstrated remain false.

claims.statement: Absent AHA case is UNAVAILABLE; REVIEWABLE is not empirical corroboration or adoption.
limitations: Separate evolving proposals are not accepted main capability.

claims.statement: Normalization, context wrapping, challenge, numeric perturbation, analogy and correction are distinct operator families.
limitations: No single orchestrator is asserted to execute all operators.

claims.statement: Local Analyst/Challenge/Synthesis retains same-root selected history without proving independent corroboration.
limitations: Repeated same-model prompting is prompt diversity, not independent distributed observation.

claims.statement: Equicorrelated error averaging has variance sigma^2/m times [1+(m-1)r].
limitations: Effective sample-size expression needs positive denominator; not a runtime estimator.

claims.statement: Peer artifact transfer is a bounded authenticated edge, with external digest references that are not signatures.
limitations: Byte integrity does not establish truth or independent semantic corroboration.

claims.statement: Default-off peer model sender/receiver seams exist with bounded frames and returned text; execution requires injected native authority.
limitations: Injected grant-shaped values are not self-authenticating authority.
Canonical request/status/result frames are at most 65536 bytes; returned text is at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; declared output tokens are at most 4096 and original job window at most 120000 ms.
Legacy intake can retain an ownerless held receipt; structured intake requires an owner. Neither receipt authorizes execution.
Authorized endpoints receive readable input; no independently verified remote-retention or confidential-computation guarantee is established.

claims.statement: Maintained paired routing and installed joins do not establish live three-node model qualification.
limitations: Artifact P2P and local workbench functions are not negated; pilot remains unqualified.

claims.statement: External contribution consumers distinguish historical completion, delivery, availability and current use rights.
claims.scope: Retained external Challenge and synthesis route
limitations: A revoked execution grant does not erase history or settle every separately authorized use.

claims.statement: Custody digest chain and append-only triggers retain privileged custodian/host trust dependencies.
limitations: Not independent timestamping, globally witnessed transparency or Byzantine consensus.

claims.statement: Native TEL uses 15 preaudit rows, 18 finalized route rows and a separate human continuation; logical labels are not elapsed time.
limitations: No cross-host causal-clock or consensus implementation inferred.

claims.statement: TAF-A observes logical retained provider-response bytes while legacy aggregate quantities remain unavailable.
limitations: Not joules, FLOPs, device memory or whole-system ethical cost; missing is not zero.

claims.statement: Byte integrity, authenticated sender, lineage, observed procedure, adequate evidence and permitted use are distinct predicates.
limitations: Their composition is not a universal truth theorem.

claims.statement: Shared-reference grammar requires versioned resolution, domain/unit compatibility, permissions and residuals.
limitations: No current automatic grammar learning or lossless semantic transfer established.

claims.statement: Retrosynthesis as predecessor/dependency traversal is a proposed explanatory semantics, not a general implemented inverse engine.
limitations: Many-to-one normalization and opaque inference can prevent full replay.
Predecessors use the output projection f_y of the tuple-valued transform.

claims.statement: Proposed alternative-support semantics requires declared adequate nonempty support sets and explicit purpose, recipient and time; an empty family yields false.
limitations: No global graph current-use or repair-set solver is asserted implemented.
Availability, permission and method applicability alone do not establish set-level adequacy; evidence-free theorems require separate justification.

claims.statement: Scoped payload expiry does not erase original request, effective-message and response-text copies in all append-only events.
limitations: External exports, backups, providers and peers have separate lifecycles.

claims.statement: Raw-free evidence is not inherently anonymous, and content hashes can be linkable.
limitations: No comprehensive DLP or full erasure guarantee.
Readable endpoint and custody values are visible to authorized compute parties or privileged hosts; unrelated deployed protection layers were not audited.

claims.statement: Pinned representation, calibration, numerical, AHA, dependence, peer and lifecycle evaluations are future qualification steps.
limitations: No proposed experiment here was executed or authorized by the manuscript itself.

claims.statement: The machine companion is an authored explanatory artifact, not a production API or exported product state.
limitations: The predecessor technical reviews apply to release 1; the successor addition has a separate affected-review record. Publication remains separate and has not occurred for this successor.

claims.statement: Equal-frequency equal-amplitude ideal sine signals in fixed anti-phase cancel identically while their phase relation remains stable.
claims.scope: Analytic donor with A>0 and nonzero omega
limitations: Not a physical experiment, energy-conservation claim or result about cognition.

claims.statement: A relation-preserving treatment of well-supported objections is hypothesized to improve adjudicated support despite possibly lower agreement.
limitations: No target result; observable endpoints and counterevidence are specified separately from donor algebra.

claims.statement: The proposed Waters of Gnosis discovery spiral treats unmeasured or conflicting evidence as a cue for user-selected bounded corridors, tributaries and braids that may yield novel AHA candidates.
claims.scope: Constructive discovery integration and matched evaluation proposal, not an implemented automatic loop
limitations: Unknown or conflict is not proof of novelty, correctness, independence or authority.
The ordinary JOINED refusal remains unchanged; no extra calls or recipients are authorized by a hold.
Corridor, tributary, river, braid, terrace and reopening are inquiry functions, not physical-flow measurements or compulsory new components.
Discovery candidates, validated findings and permitted action remain separate; no target benefit was measured.

claims.statement: Permission-respecting reuse of mapped, supported artifacts may reduce repeated-work resource consumption at comparable accepted quality and coverage after full lifecycle costs are counted.
claims.scope: Section 14.3 matched-workload reuse versus recomputation study proposal, with separate resource units and a declared observation horizon
limitations: No reuse-efficiency gain or community outcome was measured by this study.
Retrieval, verification, storage, replication, transport, coordination, failure, fallback and correction costs must be included without double counting or shifting costs off the ledger.
Additional copies do not establish stronger evidence, independent corroboration or increased physical compute capacity.
Unavailable measurements remain unavailable; fewer tokens or calls do not establish FLOPs or energy savings.

claims.statement: Freedom, practical autonomy, provider choice and accountable cooperative control are primary intended design values, including when a community chooses higher resource cost.
claims.scope: Normative design objective and independently evaluated practical capabilities, not a guaranteed numeric benefit
limitations: Decentralization alone does not guarantee freedom, practical exit, privacy or fair participation.
Autonomy capabilities and resource costs require separate evaluation; no aggregate favorable numerical result is inferred.
Operational availability and failures of the stated freedoms must be evaluated; a normative commitment is not achieved implementation.
